svg.aria-label: The revision mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Peer reviewer: the comments as a roadmap (agent); Draft writer: a patch (agent); You decide (stop); Citation compliance (agent); Revised draft, the rest as limitations (agent) | paper: Peer reviewer: the comments as a roadmap (agent); Draft writer: a patch per item (agent); Citation compliance: each claim against its source's full text (agent); The citation style to confirm (stop); A claim the run cannot support (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict (stop); Peer reviewer: the re-review (agent); Draft writer: the items not resolved (agent, only when needed); Script: each patch applied, the compile, the reference checks (script); Draft writer: the response letter, for referee comments (agent, only when needed); Peer reviewer: the letter checked, a verdict per point (agent, only when needed); /writing review, unless you said no; the draft writer applies what you pick (agent, only when needed); Revised draft, the rest as limitations (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).

svg.text: Scripts and the session's own steps are left out. Not drawn because it is the same in every mode of paper: at every patch, a structural patch, a patch that does not apply or a failed script stops the run (a ruling of plan 5).
